Magila is the artist behind Thanushiya Bridal Studio. Her Instagram profile introduces her as a celebrity bridal makeup artist with a focus on luxury makeup for brides and celebrity clients.

Bridal, airbrush and glow-skin makeup are the studio’s stated specialisms. Its Instagram highlights bring together bridal looks, glamour and occasion-led work—an invitation to explore a style that feels right for your celebration.
